footer.desc: A citizen navigation platform that translates bureaucratic complexity into clear, dignified, and actionable steps.
footer.disclaimerText: SevaSignal is an independent student project created for civic guidance. It is not an official government portal and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing any government ministry or department.
footer.rights: All rights reserved. Built with empathy for Indian citizens.

modals.aboutP1: Navigating government portals in India can be overwhelming. Citizens often struggle to determine which scheme applies to them, what documents are required, or what to do when an application is stuck or rejected.
modals.aboutP2: SevaSignal was conceptualized as an empathetic, multilingual Citizen Navigation Layer. By combining structured official data with natural-language AI grounded in verified sources, SevaSignal breaks down bureaucratic jargon into clear Next-Step Cards.
modals.aboutP3: Notice: This application is an independent student project. We never collect Aadhaar numbers, OTPs, or passwords, and we never claim official government authority.
modals.faq1Q: Is SevaSignal an official government website?
modals.faq1A: No. SevaSignal is an independent guidance and educational project. We provide verified links directly to official government portals (such as Seva Sindhu, NSP, and Parivahan) where official applications take place.
modals.faq2Q: Can I submit my application directly through SevaSignal?
modals.faq2A: No. All official transactions, document uploads, and fee payments must be completed on the authorized government portal. SevaSignal provides the preparation checklist and guidance before you visit the official portal.
modals.faq3Q: How do you ensure information is accurate?
modals.faq3A: Every record in our database is linked to the official source URL and displays a verification timestamp. When information is partial, we explicitly flag it.
modals.privacyText: Your privacy and security are our highest priority. We do not store sensitive personal information such as Aadhaar numbers, bank passwords, or biometric data. Any questions submitted to the AI assistant are processed securely strictly to provide public service answers.
modals.termsText: The information provided on SevaSignal is for general informational and navigational guidance only. Government rules, eligibility criteria, and fee structures are subject to change by respective government departments. Always verify final instructions on the official department portal.
